units.source_text: 源氏内大臣看了这首诗，深为感动，觉得这件事实在太对不起朱雀院了。

en.t: When Minister Genji read this poem, he was deeply moved and felt that in this matter he had truly wronged the Suzaku Retired Emperor.

units.source_text: 他回想自己在情场上固执的性情，越发觉得深可怜悯。

en.t: As he thought back on his own stubborn nature in matters of love, he felt all the more that it was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 心想：“朱雀院自从斋宫下伊势之日起，即寄与相思。

en.t: He thought, "From the day the Saigu went down to Ise, the Suzaku Retired Emperor had already given his heart to longing for her.

units.source_text: 好容易挨过多年，盼到斋宫归京，方谓得遂初志，

en.t: After barely enduring all those years, he waited until the Saigu returned to the capital and must have thought that at last his first wish could be fulfilled,

units.source_text: 岂料又遭此变，其伤心盖可想见。

en.t: only to meet with this change as well; one can well imagine how heartbroken he must be.

units.source_text: 何况他现已让位，闲居静处，未免妒羡世事。

en.t: Moreover, he has now abdicated and lives quietly in retirement, so he can hardly help feeling envious and resentful toward worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 若教我身处其境，定然心情郁勃。”

en.t: If I were placed in his position, my own heart would surely be heavy and stifled."

units.source_text: 如此想来，便觉对他十分抱歉。

en.t: Thinking of it in this way, he felt deeply sorry toward him.

units.source_text: 深悔自己何必多此一举，害得别人悲伤懊恼。

en.t: He bitterly regretted having gone out of his way to do such a thing and causing another person such grief and distress.

units.source_text: 他对朱雀院，虽然以前一度觉得可恨，但另一方面又觉得可亲。

en.t: As for the Suzaku Retired Emperor, although Genji had once found him hateful, on another side he also felt affection and closeness toward him.

units.source_text: 因此心绪纷乱，一时茫然若失。

en.t: Because of this, his thoughts were in turmoil, and for a time he sat dazed, as if he had lost something.
